subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add unattended auto-update for installed ClawHub skills and plugins, and what trust, pinning, rollback, audit, and operator-control policy must gate it?
rationale: The implementation is feasible, but automation should not choose the product and supply-chain boundary for silently downloading and applying third-party code at gateway startup or on a schedule.

options.title: Design a gated opt-in updater
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define a default-off policy with provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or hold controls, rollback, audit logs, and failure handling.

options.title: Keep explicit updates only
options.body: Keep `openclaw skills update --all` and `openclaw plugins update --all` as the supported path, with docs for operators who intentionally schedule those commands themselves.

options.title: Split trust prerequisites first
options.body: Track signing, rollback, ClawHub review state, and update safety as prerequisite work before deciding on background automation.

recommendation.title: Design a gated opt-in updater
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define a default-off policy with provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or hold controls, rollback, audit logs, and failure handling.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across package auto-update, native ClawHub install flows, and plugin update command boundaries.
